title_fr: Algérie: polygones détaillés des limites de wilaya (69)

properties.code: wilaya code as an integer 1-69 (join key to wilayas.json)

sources.name: OpenStreetMap: commune boundaries (relation, boundary=administrative, admin_level=8) in Algeria, full geometry
sources.note: Reached through data/geojson/commune-boundaries.geojson, which this file is dissolved from.

simplification.method: None of its own. Each wilaya is the polygon-clipping union of its communes' outlines in commune-boundaries.geojson (4 decimals), holes under 5 km2 dropped, exterior rings counter-clockwise.

provenance_notes: Derived, not drawn: a wilaya's outline is the union of the outlines of the communes the records place in it (wilaya_code), so the line follows commune membership, including the 2019 and 2026 reforms and the three communes moved to Touggourt and Ghardaia.

wilaya-boundaries.geojson is unchanged and remains the simplified, hand-corrected display outline. The two agree on every wilaya's area to within 2%; this one follows commune borders and the coast at commune detail.

Licence: ODbL-1.0 is recorded, while the package itself declares SEE LICENSE IN LICENSE for its mixed terms, because the outlines are OpenStreetMap-derived; the package LICENSE and NOTICE list this file as an ODbL 1.0 part, (c) OpenStreetMap contributors. The three communes drawn from geoBoundaries ADM3 and the one derived gap (see commune-boundaries.metadata.json) are included in the unions.
Gaps between communes of one wilaya are closed by dropping holes under 5 km2; they are simplification slivers, not territory.
